itineraries.title: Chapel Hill Game Day: Tar Heels vs Notre Dame
itineraries.theme: Farmers market, museums and noon kickoff at Kenan, then a show at Cat's Cradle
itineraries.drive_time: About 35 min west of Raleigh via I-40; 15 min from Durham
itineraries.cost_range: About $40–$150 per person plus game ticket (game ticket price not listed in the feed)
itineraries.overview: A full Chapel Hill Saturday built around the noon UNC–Notre Dame kickoff. Start at the Saturday farmers market, see the Ackland before the crowds, watch the game, cool down under the Morehead dome, and end at Cat's Cradle in Carrboro.

morning.title: Chapel Hill Farmers' Market (Saturday)
morning.location: University Place, 201 S Estes Dr, Chapel Hill, NC
morning.notes: Saturday market at University Place, 8 AM–noon; go early before game traffic.

morning.title: Care & Concern: Recent Acquisitions of Modern & Contemporary Art
morning.location: Ackland Art Museum, 101 South Columbia Street, Chapel Hill, NC 27599
morning.notes: Free museum on S Columbia St; open from 10 AM, a short walk from Franklin St.

afternoon.title: North Carolina Football vs #3 Notre Dame
afternoon.location: Kenan Stadium, 104 Stadium Dr., Chapel Hill, NC 27514
afternoon.notes: Noon kickoff. Check goheels.com for tickets, gate times and the clear-bag policy.

afternoon.title: Carolina Skies (planetarium show)
afternoon.location: Morehead Planetarium and Science Center, 250 E Franklin St, Chapel Hill, NC 27514
afternoon.notes: Planetarium show on Franklin St, indoors; book on the Morehead ticket page.

evening.title: Kevin Atwater – Blush Red Tour with Jessie Mazin
evening.location: Cat's Cradle, 300 E Main St, Carrboro, NC 27510
evening.notes: Carrboro club show, about 1 mile west of Franklin St; tickets on Etix.

food.notes: 213 W Franklin St. Dishes taken from a delivery-app menu, not Panera's own site — check current menu. No vegan dish could be verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.
310 W Franklin St. Dishes taken from a Yelp menu listing, not CholaNad's own site — check current menu and hours. No vegan dish could be verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.

food.vegan_dish: Green Burrito (roasted veggies, black beans, pinto beans, guac, tofu, hot sauce)
food.notes: Franklin St. Dishes from Cosmic Cantina's own online-ordering menu (agent-read; page is script-rendered and could not be re-checked). Hours not re-checked.

alternatives.good_weather: Chance of light rain in the morning — bring a jacket and shop early.
alternatives.rain: Skip the market and start at the Ackland at 10 AM; add the 10:30 AM Magic Tree House planetarium show at Morehead.

alternatives.good_weather: Showers and thunderstorms are possible, high near 81°F — bring a poncho; umbrellas are often not allowed in stadiums.
alternatives.rain: Watch from a Franklin St restaurant and catch the noon or 1:30 PM Morehead planetarium shows.

practical_notes: Game-day traffic around Kenan is heavy; the town runs park-and-ride lots — check the Chapel Hill Transit game-day page.
Leave Raleigh by 7:15 AM to reach the market before 8 AM.
Cat's Cradle has a lot behind the club and street parking on Main St in Carrboro.

weather.summary: Chance Light Rain then Chance Showers And Thunderstorms, high near 81

itineraries.title: Raleigh Wide Open + Indigo Girls
itineraries.theme: Free downtown music festival, history tour and a big-name concert
itineraries.drive_time: Downtown Raleigh; 20–30 min from Cary, Durham or Wake Forest
itineraries.cost_range: About $30 per person without the concert; Indigo Girls tickets $73–$348
itineraries.overview: Downtown Raleigh on a festival Saturday: a free State Capitol tour, the Raleigh Wide Open stages on Fayetteville St, the festival's book events at the City Museum, and Indigo Girls with Linda Perry at Memorial Auditorium.

morning.title: Free Guided Tour of N.C. State Capitol (three start times: 11 a.m., 1 p.m., and 3 p.m.)
morning.location: North Carolina State Capitol, 1 East Edenton Street, Raleigh, NC 27601
morning.notes: Free guided tour of the 1840 Capitol; tours run from 11 AM.

afternoon.title: Raleigh Wide Open Music Festival
afternoon.location: 100 Fayetteville Street, 100 Fayetteville Street, Raleigh, NC
afternoon.notes: Free outdoor stages along Fayetteville St from noon.

afternoon.title: Raleigh Wide Open Book Events at Raleigh City Museum
afternoon.location: City of Raleigh Museum, 220 Fayetteville St, Raleigh, NC 27601-1358
afternoon.notes: Free author events at the City of Raleigh Museum on Fayetteville St — the indoor stop of the day.

evening.title: Indigo Girls w/ special guest Linda Perry
evening.location: Memorial Auditorium at Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts, 2 E. South St., Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: Memorial Auditorium is at the south end of Fayetteville St, a walk from the festival. Tickets on Ticketmaster.

food.notes: 421 Fayetteville St. 100% plant-based; its site confirms Saturday breakfast (hours not listed on the page). Dishes named are from the main menu — the Saturday breakfast menu may differ.
901 W Morgan St. Weekend brunch Sat 10 AM–2:30 PM per its site. Dishes named came from its online-ordering (catering) menu and may not be on the brunch menu.
421 Fayetteville St, near Memorial Auditorium. 100% plant-based menu (elementgastropub.com/menu). Saturday evening hours not listed on the page.

alternatives.good_weather: Chance of showers and storms in the afternoon, high near 81°F — watch the forecast and bring rain gear.
alternatives.rain: Move indoors: the NC Museum of Art (Seeing Red exhibition, Public Tour at 1 PM) or The Market at NCMA, 11 AM–4 PM.

practical_notes: Downtown decks near Fayetteville St fill early on festival days; the Moore Square and Convention Center decks are close.
GoRaleigh buses and the free R-Line circulator serve downtown.
Leave Durham or Cary by 10:15 AM to make the 11 AM Capitol tour.

weather.summary: Chance Light Rain then Chance Showers And Thunderstorms, high near 81

itineraries.title: Durham Sunday: Open Streets and the Blues Ramble
itineraries.theme: Car-free downtown streets, a free blues festival and a pumpkin train
itineraries.drive_time: About 30 min from Raleigh via I-40/NC-147
itineraries.overview: Downtown Durham closes streets to cars for Move-A-Bull City while the Bull City Blues Ramble plays free sets around Motorco. Start with the pumpkin train at the Museum of Life and Science and finish with Weatherday at Motorco.

morning.title: Pumpkin Patch Express
morning.location: Museum of Life and Science, 433 W Murray Ave, Durham, NC 27704
morning.notes: Pumpkin Patch Express at the Museum of Life and Science, from 9:30 AM.

afternoon.title: Move-A-Bull City Open Streets!
afternoon.location: Downtown Durham (Blackwell, Corcoran and Foster streets), Foster St, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: Open streets downtown from noon to 4 PM — walk, bike or skate.

afternoon.title: Bull City Blues Ramble
afternoon.location: Motorco Music Hall, 723 Rigsbee Avenue, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: Free blues sets; Motorco is on Rigsbee Ave at the edge of the open-streets route.

afternoon.title: Black Farmers' Market in Durham
afternoon.location: Durham Technical Community College, main campus, 1637 E Lawson Street, Durham, NC
afternoon.notes: Black Farmers' Market at Durham Tech, 1–4 PM, a 5-minute drive east.

evening.title: Weatherday with Girl Brutal / Blankstate / The Lost View
evening.location: Motorco Music Hall, 723 Rigsbee Avenue, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: Indoor rock show at Motorco, doors and tickets on the Motorco page.

food.vegetarian_dish: Veggie Breakfast Burrito — scrambled eggs, tomatoes, green peppers, onions (.90)
food.notes: 776 9th St (Ninth St, not downtown — 5 min drive). Sat–Sun 7 AM–3:30 PM per its site. No vegan dish could be verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.
Inside Motorco, 723 Rigsbee Ave. Menu page is script-rendered and could not be re-checked; Sunday hours not confirmed. No vegan dish could be verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.
644 Foster St. Dishes and hours from a third-party menu site (zmenu), not the restaurant's own — check before going.

alternatives.good_weather: Rain is forecast all day Sunday, high near 69°F — check the organizers' pages for weather changes before you go.
alternatives.rain: Spend the afternoon indoors at the Museum of Life and Science or the Nasher Museum, then catch the Ramble's indoor sets at Motorco.

practical_notes: Streets on the open-streets route are closed to cars noon–4 PM; park in a downtown deck before noon.
Motorco has a lot on Rigsbee Ave; the Durham Station area decks are a 10-minute walk.

itineraries.title: Raleigh Tuesday: Free Museums and Bleachers at Red Hat
itineraries.theme: Free museums by day, an outdoor amphitheater show at night
itineraries.drive_time: Raleigh; 25–30 min from Durham or Chapel Hill
itineraries.cost_range: About $25 per person before the concert (concert price not listed)
itineraries.overview: A sunny weekday in Raleigh: the Gregg Museum on Hillsborough St, the lobster feeding at the NC Museum of Natural Sciences downtown, and Bleachers under the sky at Red Hat Amphitheater.

morning.title: A Creek in Carolina: Artworks by Bobby C. Martin
morning.location: Gregg Museum of Art & Design, 1903 Hillsborough St., Raleigh, NC 27607
morning.notes: Free; the Gregg is on Hillsborough St across from NC State.

afternoon.title: Live Animal Feeding: Lobster
afternoon.location: NC Museum of Natural Sciences, 11 W Jones St, Raleigh, NC 27601
afternoon.notes: Free 15-minute animal feeding inside the museum downtown.

evening.title: Bleachers Forever
evening.location: Red Hat Amphitheater, 500 S McDowell St, Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: Outdoor amphitheater by the convention center; tickets on Ticketmaster.

food.notes: Downtown Raleigh. Dishes taken from a Visit Raleigh listing, not Sitti's own menu — check current menu and hours. No vegan dish could be verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.
901 W Morgan St. Dinner Tue–Thu 4:30–9 PM per its site. Dishes from its online-ordering (catering) menu; dinner menu may differ.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, high near 69°F, falling to the upper 40s after dark — bring a layer for the evening.
alternatives.rain: If plans change, Public Image Ltd plays indoors at Lincoln Theatre at 8 PM.

practical_notes: Red Hat sits next to the convention center; the convention center deck is the closest parking.
Hillsborough St metered parking near the Gregg; the museum has a small lot.

itineraries.title: Durham Wednesday: Farmers Market to Carolina Theatre
itineraries.theme: Midweek market at Durham Central Park and a guitar night downtown
itineraries.drive_time: About 30 min from Raleigh via I-40/NC-147
itineraries.cost_range: About $30–$60 per person plus concert ticket (price not listed)
itineraries.overview: An easy Durham weekday: the Wednesday farmers market at Durham Central Park, dinner nearby, then the Kenny Wayne Shepherd Band at the Carolina Theatre. Robert Lester Folsom with Liz Cooper at Motorco is the alternative show.

afternoon.title: Wednesday Market (Durham Farmers' Market)
afternoon.location: Durham Central Park, 501 Foster Street, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: Wednesday market 3–6 PM at the Durham Central Park pavilion.

evening.title: Kenny Wayne Shepherd Band
evening.location: Carolina Theatre of Durham, 309 W Morgan St, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: Historic downtown theater; tickets on the Carolina Theatre site.

evening.title: Robert Lester Folsom with Liz Cooper
evening.location: Motorco Music Hall, 723 Rigsbee Avenue, Durham, NC 27701

food.vegetarian_dish: Onion Uttapam (Vegan, GF - thick crepe topped with onion)
food.notes: 811 9th St. Dishes and hours from Yelp, not the restaurant's own site — check before going. No vegan dish could be verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.

food.vegetarian_dish: Spring Vegetable Salad (fennel, cucumbers, celery, chickpeas, lemon vinaigrette)
food.notes: 644 Foster St, near Durham Central Park. Dishes and hours from a third-party menu site (zmenu) — check before going.

alternatives.rain: The market is under a covered pavilion; in rain, stay close and duck into the Foster St shops.

practical_notes: The Durham Central Park lot fills during the market; there is street parking on Foster and Hunt St.
The Carolina Theatre is a 10-minute walk from the park.

itineraries.title: Good Moon Festival Opening Night in Durham
itineraries.theme: Free museum day, garden walk and Sylvan Esso opening the Good Moon festival
itineraries.drive_time: About 30 min from Raleigh via I-40/NC-147
itineraries.cost_range: About $50–$120 per person plus the DPAC ticket (price not listed)
itineraries.overview: Durham Community Day makes the Museum of Life and Science free, Duke Gardens hosts Meet the Keepers, and Sylvan Esso with Meshell Ndegeocello opens the Good Moon festival at DPAC, with a late aftershow at The Pinhook.

morning.title: Durham Community Day
morning.location: Museum of Life and Science, 433 W Murray Ave, Durham, NC 27704
morning.notes: Free admission for Durham Community Day, from 10 AM.

afternoon.title: Meet the Keepers
afternoon.location: Sarah P. Duke Gardens, 420 Anderson St, Durham, NC 27705
afternoon.notes: Free talk in the gardens on Anderson St.

evening.title: Good Moon Festival: Sylvan Esso with Meshell Ndegeocello
evening.location: DPAC (Durham Performing Arts Center), 123 Vivian St, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: DPAC at American Tobacco; tickets on Ticketmaster.

evening.title: Good Moon Pres. Star Moles w/ Brotherkenzie [OFFICIAL FESTIVAL AFTERSHOW]
evening.location: The Pinhook, 117 West Main Street, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: Official Good Moon aftershow at The Pinhook, $40.

food.vegetarian_dish: Veggie Breakfast Burrito — scrambled eggs, tomatoes, green peppers, onions (.90)
food.notes: 776 9th St. Mon–Fri 7 AM–3 PM per its site. No vegan dish could be verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.

food.vegan_dish: Salad Rolls (marked VG, GF) — avocado, red pepper, carrots, lettuce, herbs, peanut sauce
food.vegetarian_dish: Grilled Lemongrass Banh Mi with tofu (marked VG)
food.notes: 737 9th St, near Duke East Campus. Dishes from jujudurham.com/lunch; Thursday lunch hours not listed on that page.

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly sunny, high near 75°F — a good afternoon for the gardens.
alternatives.rain: Swap for the Nasher Museum of Art on Campus Dr, indoors.

practical_notes: DPAC is next to the American Tobacco Campus; the Bullington and Diamond View decks are closest.
The Pinhook is on W Main St, about a 10-minute walk from DPAC.
